evidence: The track starts at Woolshed Creek car park at the end of Jig Road.
Follow a historic tramway that runs beside Woolshed Creek, passing through attractive beech forest.
The track flattens out at the site of the old Blackburn Mine.
From the mine, the track climbs to a high point (trig R, 934 m) with superb views of the upper Ashburton Gorge, before descending to Woolshed Creek Hut.

doubts: The main way is recorded as one_way from DOC's '5.1 km one way' and the text's one-way route from the car park to the hut. The text also says 'For a day walk, you can do a return walk to Woolshed Creek Hut', which would make it out_and_back by return; that is not recorded as a separate way. No road-end feature is in the packet, so the car park start has no ref. The 4WD track and the Sidewinder Track each have their own heading, so they are separate ways, but the text does not say where either starts, so their starts are null. The Sidewinder Track's end is where it links with the main track at the old Blackburn Mine. The 4WD track has no time or distance of its own ('takes about the same time'). The circuit route (W4) is one-way from the hut to the car park, and it becomes a circuit only together with W1. The text's 'Ttacks' is a typo in the source and is copied as written. Bus Stop Track ref T1 is an inference from the packet's map track name for 'Bus Stop', so it is the least certain ref in the reading.
